conf.description: SQL Server Audit audit-security-log / windows-event: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: sqlserver-audit / audit-security-log / windows-event. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Microsoft SQL Server integration (audit data stream)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
